pages.title: Where to find
pages.text: Look for the encounter at: Burning Arena.

pages.title: How to fight
pages.text: At the Burning Arena the Revenant guards the route to Ignis. Its shields can be broken by a fully charged critical axe hit. Wait for the attack to recharge, land a jumping critical, and leave before its answering breath. Burning Ashes are used at the Altar of Fire.

pages.title: What does not work
pages.text: Possessing an item does not replace a recorded victory.

pages.title: Drops
pages.text: Native loot for this encounter includes: Burning Ashes. Inspect the obtained item’s uses in JEI to choose your next equipment. Possessing an item does not replace a recorded victory.
